Bamboo Veneer

Bamboo veneer is sliced from rapidly renewable resources bamboo blocks, exotic and green material for replacement of wood veneer, longer and wider sheet, greater hardness, easier processing.

Click Strand Bamboo Flooring

Click strand woven bamboo flooring, our premium offering, combines beauty, strength, durability, replicates the grain of traditional hardwood. DIY flooring, glue-less and fast installation.

Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring

Strand woven bamboo is the fastest growing segment of bamboo sales, the most expensive, most durable, highest density, hardest, commercial grade and excellent hardness of bamboo flooring.

Wide Plank Bamboo Flooring

Wide plank bamboo flooring is long and wide plank, 3-layer cross laminated, providing highest stability, requiring fewer planks compared than classic bamboo, having fast installation.

Solid Bamboo Flooring

Solid bamboo flooring comes in 4 basic varieties, is made strictly from 100% renewable resource - bamboo, tongue and groove, largest sales on bamboo. Stained colors available to achieve demands.

bamboo molding includes skirting board, quarter round, t-molding, threshold.
